links.outcome: Deviation of LLM responses from evidence-based guidelines on psoriasis questions
links.effect: 12.5% of responses deviated from evidence-based guidelines, particularly on complex topics like biologics and management; mean scores ranged from 5.95 to 9.88.
links.quote: However, 12.5% of responses deviated from evidence-based guidelines, particularly on complex topics like biologics and management.

links.outcome: LLM responses proactively directing users to consult a physician and avoiding dangerous content
links.effect: All responses avoided dangerous content and 87.5% proactively emphasized the necessity of consulting a physician, but 12.5% deviated from guidelines.
links.quote: All responses avoided dangerous content, and 87.5% proactively emphasized the necessity of consulting a physician.

screen.reason: Multicenter expert evaluation of four Chinese LLMs answering clinical psoriasis questions for patient education, evaluating accuracy, completeness, clarity, and safety without testing a specific deployment practice.
